adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the condition for setting `organization.create.slug` was flipped from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`. This means when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, the org is now created with no `slug` at all (verifiable from the diff). While the finding claims the `requestedSlug` condition was left unchanged, it was also rewritten but remains gated on `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`, so with team billing enabled both `slug` and `metadata.requestedSlug` are set, which is internally inconsistent with a “requested/approval” flow. The inversion and resulting missing slug for the non-team-billing path is a concrete behavioral regression introduced by this diff.
